welcome.title: Welcome to RailLOOP
welcome.content: RailLOOP is a personal railway diary web app designed to help you track and manage your railway journeys, visually presenting and sharing your travel footprints.

tabRecords.title: Trip Records
tabRecords.content: This tab is your journey's command center. You can view, add, and manage all railway trip records here, or add them to your collections.

addTrip.title: First Record
addTrip.content: Click the floating 'New Trip' button below to open the session editor.

editorModes.title: Editor Modes
editorModes.content: Choose 'Manual' to pay homage to the craftsmanship of old, or try 'Auto' to leave your fate to the Infinite Improbability Drive.

autoPlanningView.title: Auto Planning
autoPlanningView.content: Select origin and destination here; the system will plan a route prioritized by Shinkansen. Once done, let's continue.

closeEditor.title: Close Editor
closeEditor.content: Close it for now. Continue exploring other parts of the ship, don't let the editor block your view.

importExport.title: Escape Pods
importExport.content: We believe your data belongs to you—provided you know how to back it up. Export your trips to KML/JSON here.

tabMap.title: Map Mode
tabMap.content: Toggle to view the railway network. Grey segments are unridden, while ridden ones are highlighted. The base map features detailed alignment from OpenRailwayMap. In this version, we've replaced SVG rendering with rich station interactions: long-press and drag between stations to auto-plan.

mapPins.title: Map Pins
mapPins.content: Pin photos or comments to the map here. It's likely sturdier than a certain Joseph's son's cross.

closePinEditor.title: Exit Pin Mode
closePinEditor.content: The pin editor appears at the bottom. Click the 'X' button or the FAB again to close it.

mapLayers.title: Map Styles
mapLayers.content: Switch between dark and light map styles, whether to save battery or match your midnight snacks.

tabStats.title: Aftermath
tabStats.content: Click here for stats. See how much money you've burned on the tracks of this planet and your carbon footprint (TODO).

statsContent.title: Railfan Medals
statsContent.content: Your total mileage, expenses, and most visited lines are showcased here.

finishLogin.title: RailLOOP, Easy Peasy
finishLogin.content: Tutorial finished. We'll open the login screen now. We recommend binding your GitHub account to generate cool SVG cards for show.

loginGuide.title: Read Agreement
loginGuide.content: Before you start, please read this 'User Guide' (mostly a disclaimer). If you are an alien, time traveler, or psychic, please ignore the physical limitation clauses.

loginModal.disclaimer: By using the service after registration/login, you agree to the above agreement. Otherwise, your data will only be processed locally (frontend).
